discovery.projectIdentity: sha256 of the sorted root commit ids, first 32 hex

pairing.commitReveal: client commits sha256(suite, publicKey, nonce) before it sees the authority's key
pairing.checkCode: six digits derived from the shared secret and the full transcript, shown on both devices
pairing.approval: one click on the main device; unanswered requests expire after 120 seconds

transport.associatedData: method, route, deviceId and time for requests; time and status for responses
transport.failureThrottle: ten failures per source address within five minutes

admin.authentication: bearer token in the device home, mode 0600

zeroSetupLanAuthority.singleDevice: a project with no pairing registers locally and opens no port

compatibility.preserves: v10, v15 and v18 entrypoints, intents, receipts and exact-commit behaviour are unchanged
